tagline: See every tag — and exactly which assets carry it.
problem: Tags are how the Ensemble's work reaches Tenable, but once there are hundreds of categories and values, nobody can say what exists, how many assets carry each one, or whether a tag landed where it should.
does: Explorer › Tags lists every tag in navi.db — one row per category : value with its asset count — searchable by category or value. Click a tag to see exactly which assets carry it, each linking to Asset Dossier and to the asset in Tenable.

glance.caption: Explorer › Tags's results: each category : value with its asset count; clicking a tag lists the assets that carry it.

capabilities: one row per category : value, with its asset count and when it was first and last applied.
every asset carrying the tag — host, IP, OS, ACR, AES, when it was tagged, and a Tenable link.
send the list through Notify & Report.
how: Explorer › Tags reads the tags and assets tables in your local navi.db and changes nothing. New tags appear after the next navi asset sync.
who: Anyone checking that a tag landed, auditing the tag estate, or finding the assets behind a tag.
better: Explorer › Tags reads what the tagging specialists write. Tag Removal removes what no longer belongs, and the Tagging log shows each write from the Ensemble's side.
cta: Check any tag with Explorer › Tags — and see every asset that carries it.
